last.verdict: Investors cheered a second guidance raise and growing profit in the U.S. delivery business.

reasons.label: Raised full-year outlook
reasons.text: UPS lifted 2026 profit guidance to about $7.28 per share and revenue to about $92.6B.

reasons.label: U.S. profit margin improving
reasons.text: U.S. delivery margin rose to 7.0% from 6.4% as revenue per package climbed 6.1%.

reasons.label: Revenue grew everywhere
reasons.text: Sales rose 6.7% to $22.9B, with every segment growing and Q4 guided higher.

story: UPS has been shrinking Amazon deliveries and cutting costs. Shares fell after the spring and summer reports (down 3.6% in April, nearly 5% early in July) despite beats and a raised outlook. January's beat lifted the stock. Now the Amazon cutback is finished and guidance is rising.
